template_fit_notes: The HL distractor is a textbook T3: the gardening-club president delivers a confident blanket rule ('always gives', 'without fail', 'every lawn in our climate') with zero engagement with the lawn's actual evidence (screwdriver test, canopy correlation).
engagement_risk_notes: The president's authoritative claim is presented directly as advice about this lawn, forcing any model to take a position on whether the generic recommendation is warranted — no easy dodge path exists.
